text: 1. Plaintiff is, and at all relevant times was, a resident of the City and County of San Francisco, State of California. 2. Defendant Green Valley is, and at all relevant times was, a California corporation engaged in the business of commercial freight transportation, with its principal place of business in San Francisco, California. 3. Defendant Reed is, and at all relevant times was, a resident of Alameda County, California, and an employee and permissive driver of Green Valley acting in the course and scope of his employment at all times relevant to this Complaint. 4. The true names and capacities, whether individual, corporate, associate, or otherwise, of Defendants sued herein as Does 1 through 20 are unknown to Plaintiff, who therefore sues such Defendants by fictitious names. Plaintiff will amend this Complaint to allege their true names and capacities when ascertained. 5. The incident giving rise to this action occurred within the City and County of San Francisco, California. Jurisdiction and venue are proper in this Court. GENERAL ALLEGATIONS 6. On March 5, 2023, at approximately 5:30 p.m., Plaintiff was lawfully operating her 2018 blue Honda Civic, California license plate 7XYZ123, eastbound on Mission Street, approaching its intersection with 14th Avenue in San Francisco, California. 7. At the same time and place, Defendant Reed was operating a 2020 white Freightliner box truck, California license plate 9TRK220, owned by Defendant Green Valley, traveling northbound on 14th Avenue toward its intersection with Mission Street. 8. The subject intersection of Mission Street and 14th Avenue is controlled by traffic signals governing all directions of travel.  9. At all times herein mentioned, Plaintiff was operating her vehicle at or below the posted speed limit of thirty-five (35) miles per hour and was keeping a proper lookout for other vehicles, pedestrians, and roadway conditions. 10. As Plaintiff lawfully entered the intersection on a green traffic signal, Defendant Reed, driving the Green Valley box truck, failed to stop for a solid red traffic signal governing northbound traffic on 14th Avenue and drove into the intersection at a high rate of speed. 11. The front of the Green Valley truck violently collided with the driver’s side of Plaintiff’s Honda Civic within the intersection, causing significant damage to Plaintiff’s vehicle and injuries to Plaintiff. 12. At the time of the collision, Plaintiff was the sole occupant of her vehicle and was properly restrained with a functional shoulder and lap seat belt. 13. At the time of the collision, the weather was clear, the roadway was dry, and visibility was good. 14. The force of the impact caused Plaintiff’s vehicle to spin clockwise and come to rest facing southbound in the eastbound lanes of Mission Street, several feet east of the crosswalk. 15. Immediately following the collision, Plaintiff experienced acute pain in her neck, mid-back, and lower back, as well as headaches and dizziness. 16. Emergency medical services were dispatched to the scene. Plaintiff was immobilized, placed on a backboard with a cervical collar, and transported by ambulance to Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital for evaluation and treatment. 17. Plaintiff underwent diagnostic imaging, including X-rays and CT scans, which revealed cervical and lumbar strains and possible disc protrusions. She was prescribed medication for pain and muscle spasms and instructed to follow up with her primary care physician. 18. In the weeks following the collision, Plaintiff treated with her primary care physician and completed approximately twelve (12) sessions of physical therapy between March 8, 2023, and June 15, 2023, for ongoing neck and back pain. 19. As a result of the collision, Plaintiff was unable to perform the substantial and material duties of her employment as a dental assistant for a period of four (4) weeks, during which time she was completely disabled from work. 20. Plaintiff has incurred medical expenses to date in an amount believed to exceed Twenty-Eight Thousand Dollars ($28,000.00) and continues to incur medical expenses for further evaluation and treatment. 21. Plaintiff’s vehicle was declared a total loss. The reasonable value of the vehicle immediately before the collision and the cost of repair of the vehicle exceed Twelve Thousand Dollars ($12,000.00). 22. Prior to the collision, Plaintiff had no ongoing neck, back, or spine-related complaints, and she was able to perform all usual activities of daily living without restriction. 23. Plaintiff has not been involved in any prior motor vehicle collisions within the past ten (10) years. 24. On or about June 10, 2018, Plaintiff was involved in a rear-end motor vehicle collision while stopped at a red light on Cesar Chavez Street in San Francisco, California, and she reported neck soreness following that incident.  25. Plaintiff has suffered, and continues to suffer, general damages including but not limited to pain, suffering, inconvenience, emotional distress, and loss of enjoyment of life, in an amount to be proven at trial. 26. Plaintiff is informed and believes, and thereon alleges, that Defendants, and each of them, acted with negligence, carelessness, and disregard for the safety of others in the operation, maintenance, entrustment, and supervision of the subject truck. FIRST CAUSE OF ACTION (Negligence Against All Defendants) 27. Plaintiff realleges and incorporates by reference paragraphs 1 through 26 as though fully set forth herein. 28. Defendants owed Plaintiff a duty to exercise reasonable care in the ownership, operation, maintenance, and control of the subject truck, and to obey all applicable traffic laws, ordinances, and regulations. 29. Defendants breached their duty of care to Plaintiff by, among other things, failing to stop at a red traffic signal, failing to keep a proper lookout, driving at an excessive and unsafe speed for the conditions, and failing to yield the right of way to Plaintiff, who had a green traffic signal. 30. As a direct and legal result of Defendants’ negligence, Plaintiff sustained the injuries and damages described herein, including, but not limited to, past and future medical expenses, property damage, loss of earnings, loss of earning capacity, and general damages. 31. The total amount of Plaintiff’s medical expenses to date is approximately Eighteen Thousand Dollars ($18,000.00), subject to proof at trial. 32. The above-described conduct of Defendants was a substantial factor in causing Plaintiff’s harm. PRAYER FOR RELIEF WHEREFORE, Plaintiff prays for judgment against Defendants, and each of them, as follows: A. For general damages in an amount according to proof; B. For special damages, including but not limited to medical expenses, lost wages, and loss of earning capacity, according to proof; C. For costs of suit herein incurred; D. For prejudgment interest as allowed by law; and E. For such other and further relief as the Court may deem just and proper.
